sources.snippet: For each of allenai/Emo_1b14b_1T and allenai/StdMoE_1b14b_1T it: Streams ~20M tokens of the cc_all_dressed weborganizer mix from S3, sampled uniformly across the 24 topics Runs a single forward pass and aggregates router activations into per-document expert vectors (top-k frequency + softmax probs)
